seo.title: Business Knowledge | Connection Pilot
seo.description: Review and manage the business information Pilot uses to support your customers.

hero.title: Business knowledge
hero.description: Keep the core details Pilot uses current, then add fresh context whenever your business changes.

setup.title: Give Pilot more to work with
setup.description: Pilot will extract key details for your review. Nothing changes until you confirm it.
setup.tellDescription: Describe an update, new service, hours, pricing, policy, or anything else in your own words.
setup.fileDescription: Upload a text, CSV, Markdown, or JSON file with menus, service lists, policies, or FAQs.
setup.websiteDescription: Pilot will review the public page you provide and prepare suggested updates.
setup.reviewDescription: Check every suggested detail before it becomes part of your business knowledge.
setup.tellPlaceholder: Example: We now offer emergency furnace repair across Windsor. Weekdays are 8:00 a.m.–6:00 p.m. and the call-out fee is $129.
setup.uploadHelp: Supported: .txt, .md, .csv, and .json files up to 1 MB.

teachPilot.title: Give Pilot the information you already have
teachPilot.description: Upload recipes, price lists, service lists, spreadsheets, supplier documents, policies, or other business information. Pilot will organize it for you.
teachPilot.uploadDescription: Supported: TXT, CSV, TSV, Markdown, and JSON. You’ll review every finding before Pilot saves it.
teachPilot.tellDescription: Share an update in the Pilot chat. Pilot will recognize clear business facts and keep your existing information protected.
teachPilot.recentDescription: Confirmed information Pilot can use in future conversations.
teachPilot.recentEmpty: No confirmed information yet. Upload a supported file or tell Pilot an important business detail.
teachPilot.reviewDescription: Pilot organizes the information it finds. Confirm the facts you want saved, edit them if needed, or reject them.
teachPilot.unsupported: Pilot couldn't read this file yet. Try a supported file type or tell Pilot the information directly.

sections.coreDescription: These are the primary details Pilot uses to understand your business.
sections.knowledgeDescription: Keep these details practical and current so Pilot can answer more accurately.

fields.discloseAutomationHelp: When enabled, Pilot may identify itself as automated in customer conversations.

actions.saved: Business information saved. Pilot will use these updates in future conversations.
actions.reviewSaved: Business knowledge saved after your review.

errors.load: Unable to load your business information.
errors.save: Unable to save your business information.
errors.extract: Pilot could not prepare suggestions from that source.
